tools.name: Ledger__rebalance
tools.description: rpc Ledger::rebalance of Admin: returns Rebalanced; a violation is the server error. Requires operator under the exposure's role source; the server still authorizes every request.

tools.name: Orders__cancel
tools.description: rpc Orders::cancel of Admin: returns Cancelled; its failure is the handler error OrderError. Requires operator under the exposure's role source; the server still authorizes every request.

notes.authorization: requires is checked against this exposure's role source at the serve site, before a request is queued: a boundary check, never a proof over the program's internal call paths
notes.lifecycle: a request accepted runs to completion: a timeout or a lost connection does not mean it did not run, and ending the wait never rolls it back
